hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; grep -qE '^fmt:' Makefile 2>/dev/null || exit 0; make fmt FILE="$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "make fmt failed after editing $f" >&2; exit 0

grep -q '"stop_hook_active": *true' && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; grep -qE '^check:' Makefile 2>/dev/null || exit 0; g=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; b=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse HEAD); [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] && [ "$b" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ] && exit 0; k=$({ git rev-parse HEAD; git diff HEAD; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard -z | xargs -0 -r sha1sum; } 2>/dev/null | sha1sum | cut -c1-40); [ "$(cat "$g/claude-check-ok" 2>/dev/null)" = "$k" ] && exit 0; if out=$(make check 2>&1); then echo "$k" > "$g/claude-check-ok"; exit 0; fi; printf 'make check fails. Fix it before finishing, or tell the user it is red and why.\n%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -n 40)" >&2; exit 2

grep -q '"stop_hook_active": *true' && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; g=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; b=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse HEAD); ch=$({ git diff --name-only "$b"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u); printf '%s\n' "$ch" | grep -qE '^(src|app|routes|resources|lib|database)/' || exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$ch" | grep -qE '(^|/)(AGENTS|README)\.md$|^docs/' && exit 0; k=$(printf '%s' "$ch" | sha1sum | cut -c1-40); [ "$(cat "$g/claude-docs-reminded" 2>/dev/null)" = "$k" ] && exit 0; echo "$k" > "$g/claude-docs-reminded"; echo 'Source files changed but AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/ did not. If commands, layout, behaviour or gotchas changed, update them; otherwise say "docs unchanged: <reason>" and stop.' >&2; exit 2
